problem.text: Two mathematicians take a morning coffee break each day. They arrive at the cafeteria independently, at random times between $9$ a.m. and $10$ a.m., and stay for exactly $m$ minutes. The probability that either one arrives while the other is in the cafeteria is $40\%$, and $m = a - b\sqrt{c}$, where $a, b$, and $c$ are positive integers, and $c$ is not divisible by the square of any prime. Find $a+b+c$.

steps.title: Where to start: draw the two arrival times as a point in a square
steps.body: The arrival times can be any real numbers in an hour, so there is nothing to count. Instead, let $x$ and $y$ be the two arrival times in minutes after $9$ a.m. The pair $(x, y)$ is a random point in the square $0 \le x \le 60$, $0 \le y \le 60$, and a probability is the area of the good region divided by the area of the square.

your_turn.prompt: What is the area of the whole square?

steps.title: Describe the event as a region
steps.body: If $x \le y$, the second person arrives while the first is still there exactly when $y - x \le m$. If $y \le x$, the condition is $x - y \le m$. Together: $|x - y| \le m$, a band along the diagonal of the square. Outside the band are two corner triangles, one where $y - x > m$ and one where $x - y > m$.

your_turn.prompt: The triangle where $y - x > m$ has its right angle at $(0, 60)$. How long are its legs, and what is the total area of the two triangles?
your_turn.answer: Each leg is $60 - m$ (from $(0, m)$ up to $(0, 60)$, and from $(0,60)$ across to $(60 - m, 60)$). Each triangle has area $\frac{(60-m)^2}{2}$, so both together have area $(60 - m)^2$.

steps.title: Set up the equation
steps.body:
The band is the $40\%$ we are told about, so the two triangles are the other $60\%$ of the square. Careful: do not set the triangles equal to $40\%$.
$$(60 - m)^2 = 0.6 \cdot 3600 = 2160$$

your_turn.prompt: When you take the square root, should $60 - m$ be $+\sqrt{2160}$ or $-\sqrt{2160}$? Why?
your_turn.answer: $+\sqrt{2160}$, because if $m \ge 60$ the two would always meet (probability $100\%$, not $40\%$). So $m < 60$ and $60 - m$ is positive.

steps.title: Put it together
steps.body: Since $2160 = 144 \cdot 15$, we get $60 - m = 12\sqrt{15}$, so $m = 60 - 12\sqrt{15}$ (about $13.5$ minutes). Here $15 = 3 \cdot 5$ has no square factor, so $a = 60$, $b = 12$, $c = 15$ and $a + b + c = 87$. The answer is **$87$**.
